label: Questions agencies ask
description: The five objections before committing a client, as an FAQ with two columns.

props.title: What agencies ask before committing a client to it

items.title: Will this still be here in two years?
items.description: Four years of releases in the same repository, every Astro major supported within six days, and eighteen months of security fixes per major.

items.title: Can the client edit the site?
items.description: Pages are JSON. The builder edits them; so does any editor that can open a file.

items.title: What if a widget is not what we need?
items.description: Eject it: the copy is yours, imported by path, and the page keeps working because the contract is the schema.

items.title: Is there a licence fee?
items.description: MIT. The template is free; the extras are optional.
